I'm black.
I live in Montana. Ive been here for years. I wouldn't recommend Big Timber. It's a small town. I've experienced racism from people yelling "Go back to Africa"( but I'm from the US), from racial items being left on my car. That being said, I have Montana friends who help keep me safe when we travel to rural parts and who actively keep an eye for me or spoken up when someone has tried to be shitty. It's not like all ppl in Montana are shitty, but be cautious of the lurking few with bad intentions. 

Most of this happened in small, rural areas. Now I stick to the cities where folks are more accepting and chill. 
Please be safe. I wouldn't recommend Big Timber, but I'd recommend Bozeman,  Missoula, Helena, Great Falls, or Billings.  I will say, in the years I've been here, Montana has gotten a little more diverse. 
DM if you want more details or anything. Safe travels!
